machine_profile.summary: Generic template for steel and foundry heat-treatment and melting equipment: walking-beam reheating furnaces, induction and electric-arc melting, cupolas, sinter strands and quench systems.
machine_profile.typical_duty: Continuous 24-hour operation at 900 to 1,650 C with campaign shutdowns; melt shops cycle by heat or tap.

operating_parameters.label: Furnace zone temperature
operating_parameters.why_it_matters: Overheating wastes fuel and grows scale; underheating causes mill cobbles.

operating_parameters.label: Furnace pressure
operating_parameters.why_it_matters: Negative pressure pulls cold air in through doors and leaks.

operating_parameters.label: Excess combustion air
operating_parameters.why_it_matters: Each 10% extra excess air costs about 2 to 4% fuel.

operating_parameters.label: Combustion air temperature after the recuperator
operating_parameters.why_it_matters: A drop means recuperator fouling or leaks and lost heat recovery.

operating_parameters.label: Steel discharge temperature
operating_parameters.why_it_matters: Temperature spread across the billet affects rolling quality.

operating_parameters.label: Skid or coil cooling-water flow
operating_parameters.why_it_matters: Low flow risks skid-pipe or coil failure.

operating_parameters.label: Induction coil water outlet temperature
operating_parameters.why_it_matters: High outlet temperature signals scaling or low flow.

operating_parameters.label: Baghouse differential pressure
operating_parameters.why_it_matters: High dP means blinded bags; a sudden drop means a burst bag.

operating_parameters.label: Specific fuel consumption
operating_parameters.why_it_matters: The main energy and CO2 indicator.

job_types.name: Furnace door seal and jamb rebuild
job_types.trigger: Visible flame or air ingress at the doors, or each campaign stop
checklist: Inspect the door jambs and the sealing faces
Replace the ceramic-fibre rope and the seal blocks
Check the furnace pressure control after restart
safety_and_permit_notes: Hot-work permit if cutting, welding or grinding
Heat-resistant gloves and face shield; allow cooling to below 50 C
Ceramic-fibre dust: use a respirator

job_types.name: Recuperator inspection and tube repair
job_types.trigger: Combustion-air temperature down 50 C, or annually
safety_and_permit_notes: Confined-space entry permit, gas test and standby attendant
Hot-work permit if cutting, welding or grinding

job_types.name: Hearth and wall refractory gunning
job_types.trigger: Shell hot spots or hearth erosion at inspection
checklist: Map hot spots with a thermal camera
Gun or cast the refractory in the eroded zones
safety_and_permit_notes: Confined-space entry permit, gas test and standby attendant
Dust and silica exposure control

job_types.name: Walking-beam and skid alignment check
checklist: Check the hydraulic lift and travel cylinders
Inspect the skid riders and the insulation
safety_and_permit_notes: Lock-out / tag-out and zero-energy verification before opening
Hydraulic stored-energy release

job_types.name: Electrode regulator and arm service
checklist: Inspect the electrode clamps and contact pads
safety_and_permit_notes: High-voltage isolation and earthing
Permit to work on the furnace transformer

job_types.name: Induction coil cooling-water service
job_types.trigger: Coil outlet temperature high, or quarterly
checklist: Check the water conductivity and the flow
Flush or descale the coil circuits
Inspect the hoses and the coil insulation
safety_and_permit_notes: Lock-out / tag-out and zero-energy verification before opening
Never test with molten metal in the furnace

job_types.name: Baghouse and fume-extraction maintenance
job_types.trigger: dP out of range, visible emission, or monthly
checklist: Locate burst bags with a dye or particle test
Verify the fan damper and duct leaks
safety_and_permit_notes: Confined-space entry permit, gas test and standby attendant
Lock-out / tag-out and zero-energy verification before opening
Dust exposure: respirator

job_types.name: Burner air-fuel ratio tuning
job_types.trigger: Excess air outside the band, or quarterly
checklist: Tune the ratio per zone with a flue-gas analyser
Record specific fuel consumption before and after
safety_and_permit_notes: Gas-train isolation and leak test
Heat-resistant gloves and face shield; allow cooling to below 50 C

job_types.name: Combustion-air and extraction fan service
checklist: Check the bearings and the coupling
safety_and_permit_notes: Lock-out / tag-out and zero-energy verification before opening

job_types.name: Quench and scale-pit water treatment
job_types.trigger: Oil sheen or suspended solids above limits, or weekly
checklist: Skim oil from the scale pit
Test the recirculated water for oil and suspended solids
safety_and_permit_notes: Slippery edges: fall protection near the pit
Oily waste goes to an authorised handler

job_types.name: Slag handling and spill clean-up
job_types.trigger: Spill outside the slag bay, or each shift
checklist: Collect it into the designated slag bay
Record the quantity and the disposal route
safety_and_permit_notes: Molten slag explosion risk with water: never quench uncontrolled
Heat-resistant gloves and face shield; allow cooling to below 50 C

snag_types.name: Door seal air ingress
symptoms: Cold air drawn in at the door jambs
Flame or glow visible around a closed door
Furnace pressure going negative and zone temperature falling
snag_types.detection_method: Visual check at each door and the furnace-pressure trend; thermal image of the door frame

severity_levels.definition: First sign of door seal air ingress: cold air drawn in at the door jambs noticed at inspection; no measurable effect on output, energy use or emissions. Log it and watch at the next round.
Minor: cold air drawn in at the door jambs confirmed; energy or quality penalty under about 2%. Plan the repair job for the next planned stop.
Moderate: flame or glow visible around a closed door; fuel use, emissions or product quality measurably worse. Repair within 7 days and check every shift.
Serious: furnace pressure going negative and zone temperature falling; a process, safety or permit limit is at risk. Repair within 48 hours and inform the shift supervisor.
Severe or failing: trip, damage or a permit breach is imminent. Stop the machine safely, isolate, and escalate: escalate if the zone temperature cannot be held or the door structure is cracked

snag_types.immediate_action: Lower the door fully, raise the furnace pressure set-point slightly, and book a seal rebuild
snag_types.escalation_criteria: Escalate if the zone temperature cannot be held or the door structure is cracked

pollution_effects.effect: Air ingress raises fuel use and CO2 per tonne and increases scale.
More scale means more mill scale and refractory waste to dispose of.

snag_types.name: Recuperator leak
symptoms: Visible leak, noise or flue gas in the air duct
snag_types.detection_method: Combustion-air temperature trend and a pressure test at the stop

severity_levels.definition: First sign of recuperator leak: combustion-air temperature lower than normal noticed at inspection; no measurable effect on output, energy use or emissions. Log it and watch at the next round.
Minor: combustion-air temperature lower than normal confirmed; energy or quality penalty under about 2%. Plan the repair job for the next planned stop.
Moderate: rising fuel per tonne; fuel use, emissions or product quality measurably worse. Repair within 7 days and check every shift.
Serious: visible leak, noise or flue gas in the air duct; a process, safety or permit limit is at risk. Repair within 48 hours and inform the shift supervisor.
Severe or failing: trip, damage or a permit breach is imminent. Stop the machine safely, isolate, and escalate: escalate if the air temperature falls more than 100 C or flue gas reaches the air side

snag_types.immediate_action: Reduce the firing rate to protect the tubes and plan an inspection
snag_types.escalation_criteria: Escalate if the air temperature falls more than 100 C or flue gas reaches the air side

pollution_effects.effect: Lost heat recovery raises fuel use, CO2 and NOx.

snag_types.name: Hearth refractory erosion
symptoms: Exposed anchors or a shell temperature above 250 C
snag_types.detection_method: Monthly thermal-camera shell scan and inspection at the campaign stop

severity_levels.definition: First sign of hearth refractory erosion: shell hot spots noticed at inspection; no measurable effect on output, energy use or emissions. Log it and watch at the next round.
Minor: shell hot spots confirmed; energy or quality penalty under about 2%. Plan the repair job for the next planned stop.
Moderate: slag pooling on the hearth; fuel use, emissions or product quality measurably worse. Repair within 7 days and check every shift.
Serious: exposed anchors or a shell temperature above 250 c; a process, safety or permit limit is at risk. Repair within 48 hours and inform the shift supervisor.
Severe or failing: trip, damage or a permit breach is imminent. Stop the machine safely, isolate, and escalate: escalate if the shell exceeds 300 C anywhere

snag_types.immediate_action: Lower the zone temperature near the hot spot and schedule gunning
snag_types.escalation_criteria: Escalate if the shell exceeds 300 C anywhere

pollution_effects.effect: Heat loss raises fuel use.
Spent refractory is a solid waste stream.

snag_types.name: Walking-beam misalignment
snag_types.detection_method: Billet tracking camera and the beam-level survey

severity_levels.definition: First sign of walking-beam misalignment: billets skewing on the beams noticed at inspection; no measurable effect on output, energy use or emissions. Log it and watch at the next round.
Minor: billets skewing on the beams confirmed; energy or quality penalty under about 2%. Plan the repair job for the next planned stop.
Moderate: uneven discharge temperature; fuel use, emissions or product quality measurably worse. Repair within 7 days and check every shift.
Serious: billet jam or beam stalls; a process, safety or permit limit is at risk. Repair within 48 hours and inform the shift supervisor.
Severe or failing: trip, damage or a permit breach is imminent. Stop the machine safely, isolate, and escalate: escalate if a billet jams inside the furnace

snag_types.immediate_action: Slow the beam cycle and watch the billet position
snag_types.escalation_criteria: Escalate if a billet jams inside the furnace

pollution_effects.effect: Longer residence time wastes fuel.
Rejected billets become scrap and scale.

snag_types.name: Skid-pipe insulation loss
symptoms: Dark skid marks on the billets
Bare skid pipes visible through the peep door
snag_types.detection_method: Cooling-water temperature rise across the skids and peep-door inspection

severity_levels.definition: First sign of skid-pipe insulation loss: dark skid marks on the billets noticed at inspection; no measurable effect on output, energy use or emissions. Log it and watch at the next round.
Minor: dark skid marks on the billets confirmed; energy or quality penalty under about 2%. Plan the repair job for the next planned stop.
Moderate: cooling-water heat pick-up rising; fuel use, emissions or product quality measurably worse. Repair within 7 days and check every shift.
Serious: bare skid pipes visible through the peep door; a process, safety or permit limit is at risk. Repair within 48 hours and inform the shift supervisor.
Severe or failing: trip, damage or a permit breach is imminent. Stop the machine safely, isolate, and escalate: escalate if the water outlet temperature approaches the boiling margin

snag_types.immediate_action: Log the extra water heat load and plan re-insulation at the stop
snag_types.escalation_criteria: Escalate if the water outlet temperature approaches the boiling margin

pollution_effects.effect: Heat lost to cooling water raises fuel use and CO2.

snag_types.name: Electrode regulator fault
snag_types.detection_method: Arc current and power trends; electrode consumption per tonne

severity_levels.definition: First sign of electrode regulator fault: arc current swinging noticed at inspection; no measurable effect on output, energy use or emissions. Log it and watch at the next round.
Minor: arc current swinging confirmed; energy or quality penalty under about 2%. Plan the repair job for the next planned stop.
Moderate: higher electrode consumption per heat; fuel use, emissions or product quality measurably worse. Repair within 7 days and check every shift.
Serious: electrode breakage or regulator trips; a process, safety or permit limit is at risk. Repair within 48 hours and inform the shift supervisor.
Severe or failing: trip, damage or a permit breach is imminent. Stop the machine safely, isolate, and escalate: escalate if an electrode breaks or the arc is lost repeatedly

snag_types.immediate_action: Switch to the backup regulation mode if available and call the electrical team
snag_types.escalation_criteria: Escalate if an electrode breaks or the arc is lost repeatedly

pollution_effects.effect: Unstable arcs raise power use and fume generation.

snag_types.name: Induction coil cooling-water leak
symptoms: Water drops at the coil hoses
Water near molten metal or a ground-fault alarm
snag_types.detection_method: Coil outlet temperature, flow switch alarms and a visual check of the hoses

severity_levels.definition: First sign of induction coil cooling-water leak: water drops at the coil hoses noticed at inspection; no measurable effect on output, energy use or emissions. Log it and watch at the next round.
Minor: water drops at the coil hoses confirmed; energy or quality penalty under about 2%. Plan the repair job for the next planned stop.
Moderate: coil outlet temperature above 55 c; fuel use, emissions or product quality measurably worse. Repair within 7 days and check every shift.
Serious: water near molten metal or a ground-fault alarm; a process, safety or permit limit is at risk. Repair within 48 hours and inform the shift supervisor.
Severe or failing: trip, damage or a permit breach is imminent. Stop the machine safely, isolate, and escalate: escalate immediately if water is near the melt

snag_types.immediate_action: If water may reach molten metal, stop power and evacuate the platform; otherwise reduce power and call maintenance
snag_types.escalation_criteria: Escalate immediately if water is near the melt

pollution_effects.effect: Contaminated cooling water may be discharged.
Extra power use from scaled coils.

snag_types.name: Baghouse bag burst
symptoms: Dust deposits around the stack and the yard
snag_types.detection_method: Stack opacity check and the baghouse dP trend; a particle counter if fitted

severity_levels.definition: First sign of baghouse bag burst: sudden drop in baghouse dp noticed at inspection; no measurable effect on output, energy use or emissions. Log it and watch at the next round.
Minor: sudden drop in baghouse dp confirmed; energy or quality penalty under about 2%. Plan the repair job for the next planned stop.
Moderate: visible dust at the stack; fuel use, emissions or product quality measurably worse. Repair within 7 days and check every shift.
Serious: dust deposits around the stack and the yard; a process, safety or permit limit is at risk. Repair within 48 hours and inform the shift supervisor.
Severe or failing: trip, damage or a permit breach is imminent. Stop the machine safely, isolate, and escalate: escalate at once if the stack opacity is visible or a permit limit is at risk

snag_types.immediate_action: Isolate the affected compartment if possible and inform EHS
snag_types.escalation_criteria: Escalate at once if the stack opacity is visible or a permit limit is at risk

pollution_effects.effect: Particulate emissions above permit limits.
Dust deposits on surrounding land.

snag_types.name: Burner air-fuel ratio drift
snag_types.detection_method: Flue-gas O2 and CO per zone against the tuning record

severity_levels.definition: First sign of burner air-fuel ratio drift: excess air outside 5 to 15% noticed at inspection; no measurable effect on output, energy use or emissions. Log it and watch at the next round.
Minor: excess air outside 5 to 15% confirmed; energy or quality penalty under about 2%. Plan the repair job for the next planned stop.
Moderate: flame colour change; fuel use, emissions or product quality measurably worse. Repair within 7 days and check every shift.
Serious: co alarms or soot; a process, safety or permit limit is at risk. Repair within 48 hours and inform the shift supervisor.
Severe or failing: trip, damage or a permit breach is imminent. Stop the machine safely, isolate, and escalate: escalate if CO stays above 400 ppm

snag_types.immediate_action: Put the zone in manual and set the ratio from a portable analyser
snag_types.escalation_criteria: Escalate if CO stays above 400 ppm

pollution_effects.effect: More fuel per tonne raises CO2 and NOx.

snag_types.name: Combustion-air fan vibration

severity_levels.definition: First sign of combustion-air fan vibration: rising vibration noticed at inspection; no measurable effect on output, energy use or emissions. Log it and watch at the next round.
Minor: rising vibration confirmed; energy or quality penalty under about 2%. Plan the repair job for the next planned stop.
Moderate: bearing noise; fuel use, emissions or product quality measurably worse. Repair within 7 days and check every shift.
Serious: air-flow fluctuation and burner trips; a process, safety or permit limit is at risk. Repair within 48 hours and inform the shift supervisor.
Severe or failing: trip, damage or a permit breach is imminent. Stop the machine safely, isolate, and escalate: escalate above 11 mm/s or a hot bearing

snag_types.immediate_action: Reduce the fan speed if allowed and plan a service
snag_types.escalation_criteria: Escalate above 11 mm/s or a hot bearing

pollution_effects.effect: Unstable air supply causes incomplete combustion.

snag_types.name: Quench water contamination
symptoms: Oil sheen on the scale pit
Oily water overflowing to the drain
snag_types.detection_method: Daily visual check of the pit and a weekly oil-in-water test

severity_levels.definition: First sign of quench water contamination: oil sheen on the scale pit noticed at inspection; no measurable effect on output, energy use or emissions. Log it and watch at the next round.
Minor: oil sheen on the scale pit confirmed; energy or quality penalty under about 2%. Plan the repair job for the next planned stop.
Moderate: turbid recirculated water; fuel use, emissions or product quality measurably worse. Repair within 7 days and check every shift.
Serious: oily water overflowing to the drain; a process, safety or permit limit is at risk. Repair within 48 hours and inform the shift supervisor.
Severe or failing: trip, damage or a permit breach is imminent. Stop the machine safely, isolate, and escalate: escalate if oily water leaves the site boundary

snag_types.immediate_action: Deploy absorbent booms and stop any overflow to the drain
snag_types.escalation_criteria: Escalate if oily water leaves the site boundary

pollution_effects.effect: Oil and suspended solids in the discharge.
Oily scale is a contaminated solid waste.

snag_types.name: Slag handling spill
symptoms: Molten slag near water or a cable trench
snag_types.detection_method: Shift inspection of the slag route and the bay

severity_levels.definition: First sign of slag handling spill: slag outside the designated bay noticed at inspection; no measurable effect on output, energy use or emissions. Log it and watch at the next round.
Minor: slag outside the designated bay confirmed; energy or quality penalty under about 2%. Plan the repair job for the next planned stop.
Moderate: slag spread onto bare ground; fuel use, emissions or product quality measurably worse. Repair within 7 days and check every shift.
Serious: molten slag near water or a cable trench; a process, safety or permit limit is at risk. Repair within 48 hours and inform the shift supervisor.
Severe or failing: trip, damage or a permit breach is imminent. Stop the machine safely, isolate, and escalate: escalate if slag reaches bare soil outside the paved area

snag_types.immediate_action: Barricade, let it solidify, and collect into the bay
snag_types.escalation_criteria: Escalate if slag reaches bare soil outside the paved area

pollution_effects.effect: Slag on unpaved ground leaches metals into soil.
Run-off from the slag area carries fines.

snag_types.name: Cupola tuyere blockage
symptoms: Tuyere fully blocked or burning back
snag_types.detection_method: Tuyere sight-glass inspection each hour and the blast pressure trend

severity_levels.definition: First sign of cupola tuyere blockage: uneven blast distribution noticed at inspection; no measurable effect on output, energy use or emissions. Log it and watch at the next round.
Minor: uneven blast distribution confirmed; energy or quality penalty under about 2%. Plan the repair job for the next planned stop.
Moderate: lower tapping temperature; fuel use, emissions or product quality measurably worse. Repair within 7 days and check every shift.
Serious: tuyere fully blocked or burning back; a process, safety or permit limit is at risk. Repair within 48 hours and inform the shift supervisor.
Severe or failing: trip, damage or a permit breach is imminent. Stop the machine safely, isolate, and escalate: escalate if two or more tuyeres are blocked

snag_types.immediate_action: Rod the tuyere if safe and check the blast pressure
snag_types.escalation_criteria: Escalate if two or more tuyeres are blocked

pollution_effects.effect: Poor combustion raises CO and coke per tonne.
